name: rakotis
description: Reusable app primitives for Enigma: non-crypto foundation (UI primitives, Tauri helpers, profile storage, local kv cache, i18n) plus P2P chat orchestration (Rotor-backed crypto bridge, iroh transport bridge, chat-channel composable, MLS envelope state machine). Crypto is delegated to the Rotor-backed mls_* Tauri commands — never reimplemented here.
